title: "dicer instance snapshot create"
description: "Snapshot a running or paused instance"
---

Snapshots a running or paused instance. A running one is paused for as
long as it takes and resumed afterwards. The name defaults to the time
the snapshot is taken.

## Usage

```console
$ dicer instance snapshot create INSTANCE [NAME]
```

Also run as `dicer instance snapshot new`.

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-D`, `--debug` | Trace every call to the daemon on stderr (or set `$DICER_DEBUG`). |
| `-r`, `--remote string` | Daemon to talk to: a remote's name, or an address (unix:///PATH or HOST:PORT) (default `$DICER_REMOTE`, then the current remote, then local). |
| `--timeout duration` | Give up on a call to the daemon after this long, e.g. 30s (0: never; streams such as logs -f and exec are not bounded). |
